run_compute_test_results: run the compute_test_results function to evaluate translated test cases for a target language like python or cpp
run_compute_all_tests_results: run compute_all_tests_results to execute test cases in parallel using a ProcessPoolExecutor and a test runner
run_translate_tests: run translate_tests to parallel-translate Java Evosuite test strings into Python or C++ using a translator
run_get_joined_func_tests_df: run get_joined_func_tests_df to merge a CSV of test data with Java function source files into a single DataFrame
run_safe_translate_test: run safe_translate_test to translate a single test with error handling that catches AssertionError and TypeError
